### 1. Request, authorisation, simulator
Corinne Halvorsen (business profile 08bc2005…, Halvorsen Field Media LLC) asks to move "Our Cloud 4 plan for halvorsenfield.com … up to Cloud 8 today - I'll pay for it myself through PayPal." Identity: email corinne@halvorsenfield.com + phone 7375550142 match the profile (2 of them; verify_customer_identity "passes when at least 2 of them match"). The simulator is passive: pays anything the agent says must be "paid or put right before the upgrade can be priced"; gives "a two-year term on the account in September" when asked about length; card 2731 expired -> PayPal at checkout. Owner: the customer runs both checkout tools (docs: "The agent unlocks this customer-side tool and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it"; "Harborline support never takes payment details").

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at 2026-10-18 11:20 CDT
Plan 489e7128… `variant_name: Harborline Cloud 4, status: active, billing_term_months: 12, term_start_date 2025-10-15, term_end_date 2026-10-15, first_term False, auto_renew True`. Today is after the term end date. Upgrade doc: "An upgrade charge is fixed only after the plan's term end date is later than today. While the plan's term end date is today or a date before today, no upgrade charge is fixed for the plan." -> the upgrade cannot be priced now; the plan must first get a term whose end date is later than today. Status active (grace: "Grace after the term end date before suspension … 5" -> runs through 20 Oct), so a renewal "may be charged only while the plan status is active or suspended" holds. Cloud 8 is Cloud 4's sole upgrade target (tier change paths). Act now: renewal then upgrade, both in this call.

### 4. Computations
**A. Overdue renewal amount** (overdue_renewal_at_checkout scope: "for a plan whose term end date is on or before today and which carries no scheduled downgrade request"; sheet overdue_renewal_amount_calculation).
- New term length: B. "a term change request in status scheduled sets the new term length to its target term in months … withdrawn … never count" -> 24.
- Regular price: Cloud 4 regular 24-month 44.99 × 24 = 1079.76.
- Reseller discount factor (reseller_discount_on_overdue_hosting_renewals): account tier on billing date Harborline Reseller Bronze -> 10 percent -> 971.784 -> 971.78. Evidence: find_account_holdings variant_name.
- Certificate bundle credit factor: active OV Single Domain installed on this plan -> USD 12.00 (find_ssl_holdings hosting_id).
- Domain bundle credit factor: active registration naming this plan; latest renewal line 17.64 alone on 2026-09-15, unrefunded, no later restore -> 17.64/1 = 17.64 (find_domain_holdings bundled_hosting_id; find_domain_charges).
- Mail bundle credit factor: active Professional Email on primary domain, 6 seats (>=5) -> USD 20.00 (find_email_holdings) — email-derived, conditional.
- Late renewal fee factor: 3 whole days from 15 Oct to 18 Oct (>2); 3 declined attempts dated less than one calendar month before today -> "USD 3.50 for each whole day" -> 10.50.
- Assembly: credits 49.64 (< half of 971.78); 971.78 − 49.64 + 10.50 = **932.64**.
- Fall-back (calculation sheet only, no factor): 1079.76 — definite and different.

**B. Cloud 8 upgrade charge** after the renewal (post-state per tool description: term 2026-10-15..2028-10-15, billing term 24, first-term flag cleared).
- Cloud 8 term price: 24-month, not first term (paying line is a renewal, not the initial term line) -> 79.99 × 24 = 1919.76; no account tier discount ("The Cloud 8 term price takes no account tier discount").
- Amount paid for current term: renewal line paid at checkout with period start 2026-10-15 -> 932.64; no upgrade lines.
- Difference 987.12.
- Billed share factor (cloud_8_upgrade_share_by_term_length): 24-month term, whole calendar months from 18 Oct 2026 to 15 Oct 2028 counted on each 18th reached: 23 -> 23/24 -> 945.99.
- Welcome credit factor: no upgrade proration line at all -> USD 25.00.
- Outgrown-plan credit factor: notices dated less than one calendar month before today (after 18 Sep): the 18 Sep over-limit notice is exactly one calendar month before (and earlier in the day than 11:20) -> excluded; warnings on 29 Sep, 5 Oct, 11 Oct remain -> USD 20.00.
- Mail bundle credit factor (Cloud 8 upgrade): 6 seats -> USD 20.00 (conditional, email).
- Assembly: credits 65.00 (< half); 945.99 − 65.00 = **880.99**.
- Fall-back (computation doc only, on the same paid amount): 987.12 × 728/731 = 983.07 — definite and different.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root: Cloud 8 upgrade charge (customer's own checkout write).
- Hop 1 (root waits on renewal) — **state-derived**: upgrade doc sentence "An upgrade charge is fixed only after the plan's term end date is later than today." + hosting record term_end_date 2026-10-15 <= today. Searching "term end date" / "term dates move": overdue_renewal_at_checkout governs a checkout renewal "for a plan whose term end date is on or before today" and its tool moves "the plan's current term dates … to the new term" beginning "on the day the previous term ended". Early renewal is excluded by its scope ("term end date is later than today"); auto-renew is exhausted (renewal_terms clause 6: three declined attempts = 1 + 2 retry days -> "no further automatic attempt is made"). Only the overdue renewal produces the waited-on state.
- Overdue renewal itself: no prerequisite sentence in its documents; status active; not cancel-pending.
- Order: overdue renewal (with the scheduled 24-month request) -> upgrade priced on the new term.
- Counter-proof "do only the upgrade": the upgrade doc says no upgrade charge is fixed while term end <= today, so a charge priced on the expired 2025-10-15..2026-10-15 term is not allowed.
- Closest alternatives excluded: 12-month renewal (scheduled request sets 24; persona confirms); early-renewal pricing (scope excludes term end <= today); Cloud 4 rate or tier discount on the upgrade (Cloud 8 term price, no discount); introductory Cloud 8 rate (paying line not the initial term line); days-ratio share (24-month term with whole months remaining uses months/24); 40.00 outgrown credit (over-limit notice not less than one calendar month old).
